Retained = non-GM participants only (retainHydratedParticipant :430-439 returns for the host; joinMember :515-531). acknowledged rises only through noteParticipantAcknowledged :660-671, called from the CampaignAck case bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:619-626, refused above the delivered watermark (:667). The pack therefore waits for exactly that gate to answer ok (the same function), not a re-derivation.
designAnswers.convergeWaitToday: Baseline e2e/gm-two-player-performance.pack.spec.ts:630-646: max painted head across the three pages, polls each page's observer appliedSequence (set on frame receipt, :511) up to functionalWaitMs*5, then a fixed 25 ms (:644). The tail builder (:268-272) does not call converge (AllocateSalvage only, never gated) and waits with waitForSequence on the GM page (:271). waitForSequence :596-614 (called :173, :206, :271) is the 2,000 ms functional wait that reports a refused AdvanceDay as 'no painted delivery reached N'. The client transport hands a frame to onFrame listeners (campaignSyncTransport.ts:228) before it sends its CampaignAck (:244), so appliedSequence reaches the head before the ack leaves the page.
designAnswers.gmTransportRefusal: An Error frame { kind: 'Error', matchId, ts, code, reason, intentId } on the sender's socket (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:708-716, errorFrame :1550-1564; schema src/types/multiplayer/Protocol.ts ErrorMessageSchema carries intentId). The GM transport passes every parsed frame, Error included, to onFrame listeners (campaignSyncTransport.ts:228); the page reaches it through window.__CAMPAIGN_SYNC_TRANSPORT__ (src/lib/e2e/storeExposure.ts:67). The pack's intent id is perf-<kind>-<ordinal> (controlledLoopbackFixture.ts:296). The capture: the pack's own observer (already installed on the GM page) records Error frames by intent id, and the wait reads them between polls - a real read of the frame, not a timeout.
